notes.title: Whispering Fog DEMO Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]The demo for Whispering Fog is now available! Experience the dreadfully unsettling forest in this atmospheric psychological horror. [/p][p][/p][p]The demo contains the first few sections of the full game, though they are modified. The full game will not play out exactly the same, so you will not be spoiled. Events will differ and your journey will be paced differently.[/p]

notes.title: Whispering Fog Now On Steam
notes.notes: [p][b]Today is a very special day for Dark Snow Games.[/b] We’re thrilled to officially announce our upcoming video game: [i][b]Whispering Fog[/b][/i] — a psychological horror experience set deep within the eerie, atmospheric wilderness of [b]Yosemite National Park[/b].[/p][p]Step into a world where nature conceals more than beauty. In [i]Whispering Fog[/i], reality twists and fractures as you uncover haunting secrets, navigate shifting memories, and confront the unknown in a place once thought familiar. Every shadow hides a story — and not all of them want to be told.[/p][p]If you crave a chilling, immersive journey to be remembered, this one’s for you.[/p][p][b]Wishlist [i]Whispering Fog[/i] on Steam today.[/b][/p]
